restaurant_name: Pinky dental clinic (สาขาตลาดไร่วนาสินธุ์)
text:
I have some great experiences here, but also some not so good ones.

I had my first crown done here and it was done very well. They did not advise unnecessary treatment and my first doctor here was very good. But when I did go in with a lot of pain on my left side the doctor which did my crown said it was from using that side of my mouth too much. This was disappointing because I liked this dentist.
2 root canals and 4 cavities later at a different dentist, most of the pain was gone.

My recent experience getting another crown was with a new male doctor and he is very kind and welcoming. He is young and very professional. He fitted my crown at the back of my mouth and it wasn’t an easy process. He did the post and core and was very kind to remove the first crown when it did not fit well. He can offer advice and is knowledgable.

My only improvement would be that the dental assistants can sometimes not be the best. The facilities are ok, but it is a very local style place.

Receptionists are very friendly but I did have to wait nearly an hour one time and I had an appointment.

So I would recommend, but expect a variation of qualities from this place.

The treatments I have had here have been very good from the doctors and the price is affordable.
